summary.intent: Fix a failing test harness for vault key blob publishing and respond to code review feedback by adding unit tests.
summary.outcome: Fixed the axiosInstance configuration issue in the test harness, added 5 new vault unit tests (93 total passing), and pushed both fixes to CI.

repo: publishVaultKeyBlob calls createAndPublishIpnsRecord which uses orval-generated API clients requiring an axiosInstance on SdkContext — not just apiUrl + getAccessToken.
Orval-generated functions fall back to a global singleton axios instance if no axiosInstance is provided on the context, which breaks in test harnesses that don't configure the singleton.

code.finding: New file created with 5 vault unit tests covering publishVaultKeyBlob behavior.

workflow: Copilot and CodeRabbit reviews arrive shortly after push and are worth triaging immediately.
When a reviewer flags non-idempotent sequence numbers, document the call-site constraints (e.g., initial-creation-only) in a reply rather than over-engineering a fix.

friction: Test harness misconfiguration (missing axiosInstance on SdkContext) caused failures that required root-cause analysis before the fix was clear.
Had to wait ~2 minutes after push before code review comments were available to triage.
open_items: Re-publish/repair flow for IPNS records needs a different implementation that reads the current sequence number first rather than hardcoding 0n — deferred because initial publish is the only current use case.
